name: sunrise2l
_comment: Equal-mass 2-loop sunrise.  Top sector is ELLIPTIC — the pure dlog ansatz only covers the polylog (tadpole) sub-block; the elliptic master is FLAGGED by Rotation.from_canonical_form and its row will not rationalize (this is the value-fittability boundary, not a tool failure).  Kept here as the elliptic-flag regression target.
